name: Mixture Graph
definition: A novel data structure for compressing, rendering, and querying segmentation histograms. It represents hierarchical segmentation histograms as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) whose nodes are topologically ordered, allowing for pre-filtered anti-aliasing and efficient transfer function propagation.
summary: The Mixture Graph is a DAG data structure that compresses segmentation histograms by factorizing them into linear interpolations, enabling efficient parallel palette updates and interactive volume rendering.
